categories.name: Utility
categories.description: Quality-of-life improvements for stuff you do on Polytoria everyday.

categories.name: Social
categories.description: Features that improve socializing on Polytoria!

categories.name: Economy
categories.description: Tools to assist with users interested in the economy and trading.

categories.name: Expression
categories.description: Features to help Polytoria feel more like you!

categories.name: Deprecated
categories.description: Features that are on their way out and will be removed in a future update.

preferences.name: Pinned Worlds
preferences.desc: Pin your favorite worlds to the top of the homepage!

notes.text: Limit of 25 worlds pinned at once.

config.label: Notify Me When a Pinned World Updates

preferences.name: Best Friends
preferences.desc: Show off who really matters on applicable friend lists.

preferences.name: Forum Mentions
preferences.desc: Get a quick link to the popular person everyone is talking about's profile!

notes.text: Forum mentions do not notify the user or show up as a notification on their account.

preferences.name: Improved Friend Lists
preferences.desc: Accept or decline all friend requests with the click of a button! Located on the friend requests page.

preferences.name: IRL Brick Price
preferences.desc: See the real life currency value along with bricks across the site!

notes.text: All prices are purely estimations and will not be 100% accurate.

preferences.name: Hide Notification Badges
preferences.desc: Hide the annoying red circles on site navigation!

preferences.name: Store "OWNED" Tags
preferences.desc: Quickly see if you own the item at a glance with a little tag in the top left corner of item cards on the main store page!

notes.text: If the star is yellow/orange, that means the item is a collectible and hovering on the star will show your serial.

preferences.name: Free Membership Themes
preferences.desc: Ever want the fancy membership themes for completely free? Well now you can apply them on the site-wide navigation without paying a dime!

preferences.name: Multi-Cancel Outbound Trades
preferences.desc: Quickly cancel several out-bound trades (trades that you have sent) all at once!

notes.text: You can only cancel up to 10 trades at once.

preferences.name: Modify Navbar
preferences.desc: Customize the navbar to your liking!

preferences.name: Show Outfit Cost on Profiles
preferences.desc: Quickly see how many bricks a user spent on their character! Located next to the "Avatar" text at the top of profiles.

preferences.name: Show Approximate World Revenue
preferences.desc: Quickly see how many bricks a user has gained from one of their worlds! Located under the "Info" section of a world's page.

notes.text: Gamepass revenue is calculated assuming the price hasn't changed and all users that bought the gamepass, bought it at the same price that is at the time of calculating.

preferences.name: Show "Owners" instead of "Sales"
preferences.desc: Replace the "Sales" statistic with the "Owners" statistic if the item has 0 sales (most likely meaning it is an item awarded by staff).

preferences.name: Collectibles' Hoarders List
preferences.desc: List all the users that have more than 1 copy of a collectible!

notes.text: The hoarders list is limited to 2,000 number of copies to reduce the chance of ratelimiting and improve how fast the list loads.

preferences.name: Improved Achievements
preferences.desc: Quality-of-life improvements to achievements on world pages.

preferences.name: Quick Library Downloads
preferences.desc: Quickly download a model (as a .ptmd file), mesh, decal, or sound right from the page showing you details about the asset!

preferences.name: Show Friend Count on Homepage
preferences.desc: See how many friends you have on your homepage/dashboard, just scroll to the "friends" section and you'll see it next to the heading!

preferences.name: Timed-Item Owner Check
preferences.desc: Click the shopping bags icon in the bottom left-hand corner of the timed item's item thumbnail to toggle an input and a button. Then just enter someone's username and it'll tell you whether they own it or not and if so what serial!

preferences.name: Hide User Ads
preferences.desc: Hide those annoying user ads!

notes.text: Ads that are shown to help support Polytoria are not hidden.

preferences.name: Multi-Decal Uploading
preferences.desc: Quickly upload several decals all at once!

preferences.name: "Collectibles" Inventory Category
preferences.desc: Show all the limited-edition collectibles in a player's inventory in a neat grid!

preferences.name: Polytoria.Trade Integration
preferences.desc: Quickly see a collectible's evaluation from the creators of polytoria.trade! Credits to them for all value information provided by the extension.

config.label: Show Value Info on Item View Page
Show Value Info for all items on Trade View Page

preferences.name: One-click Friend Join
preferences.desc: Quickly join your friends' servers by clicking the play button inside the tooltip (which shows when hovering over your friend's avatar headshot) in the "Friends" section of the homepage.

notes.text: This feature requires "World Server Share Links" to be enabled to work properly.

preferences.name: Improved World Management
preferences.desc: Develop the next hit world easier with a few management tools!

config.label: Whitelist Users by Username in Bulk

preferences.name: Basic Blocked Info
preferences.desc: See someone's player ID and join date even if they have blocked you on their profile. The information is intentionally vague as to not violate their privacy.

preferences.name: Character Sandbox
preferences.desc: Create a character with all the item possibilities available to your heart's content! Sandbox can be accessed from the button under the "Body Colors" section on the avatar customization page.

notes.text: This feature is experimental, you will probably encounter bugs.

preferences.name: "The Great Divide" Statistics
preferences.desc: Presents all statistics available for players of "The Great Divide" 2024 event. Replaces the "Historical Records" section of the profile page.

preferences.name: Playtime Tracking
preferences.desc: Track your playtime in places around Polytoria!

notes.text: Playtime tracking started June 22nd 2026. Sessions from before that date will not show up.
Play sessions are pulled from polytrack.top. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: Inline Editing
preferences.desc: Quickly edit your asset's details such as name and description on the same page as viewing the asset!

notes.text: This feature only supports worlds at this time.
This feature is not finished or polished.

preferences.name: Game Profiles
preferences.desc: Traverse a world view page that matches a world's color palette!

notes.text: World creators must request a game profile for one to be made. Since this is experimental, no game profiles have or will be made.
This feature will be expanded upon in the future.

preferences.name: Forum Unix Timestamps
preferences.desc: See a date and time that is adjusted to everyone (who is using Kiln)'s local time.

notes.text: The styling for this feature is not yet done.

preferences.name: Classic Avatar Perspective
preferences.desc: Defaults to the 2D perspective when viewing avatars on profiles.

preferences.name: Expanded Message Glance
preferences.desc: Peek at the full contents of inbox messages without leaving the inbox page.

preferences.name: Active Challenges Display
preferences.desc: Quickly check the challenges currently active (and your progress!) on a world's page.

preferences.name: "My Serial" Display on All Items
preferences.desc: Quickly check what serial you own of an item!

notes.text: The item doesn't need to be a collectible or timed item for this to show up.

preferences.name: Random World
preferences.desc: Discover something new! Roll a random world from Polytoria and jump straight in. Located next to the search bar and filter options on the worlds page.

preferences.name: Event Items
preferences.desc: On event item pages, adds a button that opens a modal showing all other items from the same event.

preferences.name: "Not for Trade" Items
preferences.desc: Keep those items you hold dearly by auto-rejecting trades that involve items (or serials of specific items) of your choosing!

preferences.name: Block Users from Trades
preferences.desc: Auto-reject any incoming trade from a user you've blocked. You can manage this from the Trade Manager

preferences.name: Quick Cancel Outbound Trades
preferences.desc: Quickly cancel outbound (sent) trades with the click of a button from your list of trades on the outbound trades page!

preferences.name: One-click Counter Trades
preferences.desc: Quickly send a counter trade for inbound (received) trades with the click of a button from your list of trades on the inbound trades page!

preferences.name: Trade Manager
preferences.desc: Manage all your trades easily! Quickly cancel or counter trades, bulk cancel trades, sort trades by received date & value, etc! Manager can be accessed from the button located on the left column of the trades page.

preferences.name: User Labels
preferences.desc: Shows "Inactive" and "OG" badges next to the names of users across the site. Applies to the list of owners on collectible item pages, the users page, and profiles (in the "Info" card section).

preferences.name: Past Avatar Versions
preferences.desc: Blast back to the past of someone's avatar!

notes.text: Some users may or may not be tracked, that is up to PolyTrack's discretion
Avatar versions are pulled from polytrack.top. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: World Server Share Links
preferences.desc: Quickly link someone a specific server of a world! Copy a server share link from the "Servers" tab on a world page.

preferences.name: Model Tree Inspector
preferences.desc: View the hierarchy of a toolbox model on the model page before inserting it into your world(s)!

preferences.name: 3D Clothing Preview
preferences.desc: Preview a clothing item in 3D before you buy it, right from the item page!

preferences.name: Custom Body Color Hex Codes
preferences.desc: Choose that exact color shade with an input for any hex code you can dream up in the "Custom" tab of the body part color selector modal on the avatar editor page.

preferences.name: AI Bot Forum Warnings
preferences.desc: Labels AI-generated forum bots on forum posts and replies.

preferences.name: Show User ID on Profile
preferences.desc: Shows the ID of the user in the info section of their profile under their avatar.

preferences.name: Reduce "2.0" Label Clutter on Worlds Page
preferences.desc: Shrinks the "2.0" label placed on every 2.0-compatible world with a more subtle version of your choosing. Applies to the worlds page.

options.label: Remove "2.0" labels & have "Legacy" labels for non-2.0-compatible worlds

preferences.name: Theme Creator
preferences.desc: Unleash your creativity and customize the Polytoria website to your liking!

notes.text: This feature is *very* experimental, you may run into issues. For any theme rendering related issues, please submit them to this form ->

preferences.name: Creator Comment Labels
preferences.desc: Label comments made by the creator of the world, guild, or item you're looking at.

preferences.name: Legacy Store Layout
preferences.desc: Revert the store pages to be the old layout from before February 2026.

preferences.name: Legacy Sidebar
preferences.desc: Replace the secondary navbar with the sidebar from before February 2026.

preferences.name: Quick Launch Creator Buttons
preferences.desc: Quickly launch the 1.0 or 2.0 creator from your homepage!

preferences.name: Pinned Achievements
preferences.desc: Pin your favorite achievements to showcase on your profile! Located below the "About" section on profiles.

notes.text: Limit of 5 achievements pinned at once.

preferences.name: User Aliases
preferences.desc: Don't like a user's username? Change it by going to the 3 dots next to a user's username on their profile and clicking "(Kiln) Set Alias".

notes.text: Aliases are private and do not sync, regardless of if you have a linked Kiln account.

preferences.name: Friend Request Notification Quick Actions
preferences.desc: Quickly accept or reject a friend request from the notification tray!

preferences.name: Legacy World View Layout
preferences.desc: Revert the world page to be the old layout from before February 2026.

notes.text: This feature is experimental, you will probably encounter bugs.

preferences.name: Recent Transactions on Collectibles
preferences.desc: View the last 5 transactions involving a certain collectible with a tab on the item view page.

notes.text: Recent transactions are pulled from polytoria.trade. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: User Creations Tab
preferences.desc: View a user's creations with a tab directly on their profile.

preferences.name: Avatar Mesh Downloader
preferences.desc: Download a user's full avatar as a .glb mesh from their profile (in the dropdown next to their username).

preferences.name: User Notes
preferences.desc: Hate someone? Write why in a tab on their profile.

notes.text: Notes are private and do not sync, regardless of if you have a linked Kiln account.

preferences.name: Ranking Positions
preferences.desc: Check what rank someone is on leaderboards on the left side of their profile.

notes.text: Ranks below a certain point (as by PolyTrack's discretion) are not tracked, and are thus omitted.
Ranking positions are pulled from polytrack.top. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: Localized Timestamps
preferences.desc: Automatically convert timestamps to render in the same timezone as you. Applies sitewide.

preferences.name: Auto-Refresh Data
preferences.desc: Automatically refreshes data of the asset you're looking at so you know you have the most up-to-date information.

notes.text: This only applies to worlds at the moment.

preferences.name: Sticky Navbar
preferences.desc: Keep the navbar always at the top of the page.

preferences.name: World Reviews
preferences.desc: Rate a world out of 5 stars, and even offer a short text review. You can also view what other Kiln users think about the same world!

notes.text: You need to have at least 5 minutes of playtime in a world to review it.
Reviews are only visible to other Kiln users.

preferences.name: Improved Forum Composer
preferences.desc: Postfarm with ease with an improved composer! (jk.. if you postfarm.. uh don't.. or do, I don't judge!)

config.label: Highlight Words Blocked by the Forum Filter

preferences.name: World Consumables Tab
preferences.desc: View the consumables of the world you're looking at with a tab on the world's page.

preferences.name: Server Refreshing
preferences.desc: Adds a refresh button to the servers tab so you can check for new servers without reloading the page.

preferences.name: Daily Challenges Refreshing
preferences.desc: Adds a refresh button to the daily challenges card on the homepage so you can check your progress without reloading the page.

preferences.name: Disable Infinite Scrolling
preferences.desc: Replaces automatic load-on-scroll pages with a manual "Load More" button, so content only loads when you ask for it.

preferences.name: Advanced Forum Search
preferences.desc: Replaces the forum search page with an advanced search powered by PolyTrack, adding sort, author, category, date, and post type filters!

notes.text: This does not affect the main search bar located in the navbar.
Results are provided by PolyTrack. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: Re-enable Sitewide Search
preferences.desc: Enables the search results from the search bar in the navbar that were disabled in February 2026.

notes.text: Search is exclusive to users for now.
Search results are powered by Kiln's own experimental search index.

preferences.name: "My Posts"
preferences.desc: Adds a "My Posts" button below the forum search bar that displays all of the threads and replies you've created.

notes.text: Results are provided by PolyTrack. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: Audio Toolbox Previews
preferences.desc: Quickly play any audio from the "Community Creations" tab on the site without having to go in and out of pages!

preferences.name: World Trends
preferences.desc: Analyze how your world is performing with a chart of unique visitors, players in-game, likes, and dislikes on the "Stats" section of your world management page.

notes.text: Trends are provided by PolyTrack. Thank you to them for allowing Kiln to pull from their data <3

preferences.name: Trade Viewed Indicators
preferences.desc: Makes trades on the trade list page half-transparent to signify you've already viewed them.

preferences.name: Copy Post Markdown Button
preferences.desc: Adds a "Copy Markdown" option to a forum post's options dropdown, letting you copy its raw markdown content.

preferences.name: Bookmarked Threads
preferences.desc: Adds a bookmark button to forum posts and adds a "Bookmarks" button below the forum search bar to view all of your bookmarked threads.

notes.text: Bookmarked threads are private and do not sync, regardless of if you have a linked Kiln account.

preferences.name: Condensed Joined Guilds List
preferences.desc: Condenses the long list of joined guilds on the left side of the guilds page into a simple-to-understand grid.

preferences.name: "2.0" World Labels in Creations List
preferences.desc: Labels worlds that are 2.0-compatible in the list of worlds you have edit access to on the "Creations" page.

preferences.name: Security Key Renaming
preferences.desc: Rename your account's security keys for clean management.

preferences.name: Outfit Management
preferences.desc: Adds options to rename and update saved outfits on the avatar page. Updating saves the outfit with the same name, just with the state of your current avatar.

preferences.name: Streak Freezes Counter in Navbar
preferences.desc: Quickly see how many streak freezes you have next to the streak counter in the navbar.
